outputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE standalone visual design proposal for a secret treasure room for Dungeon Empire, an evil dungeon master mobile game. The first reference is a real game screenshot: borrow its dark slate-blue chunky stones, crisp outlines and legible simplified shading, ignore ALL its UI, excavation cubes, vortex, small boxes and characters. The second reference is solely a rough guide to footprint and camera: REPLACE absolutely all four small chests shown there with ONE single grand treasure at the center. Make an entire compact roofless square 2×2-cell chamber, not a showcase of a floor texture. Use the same fixed orthographic 2:1 isometric camera across proposals, looking into the room from the foreground corner. A short ONE-cell-wide approach from lower left enters through exactly ONE fortified door in the left foreground wall. Keep the near walls cut low, far walls higher; the door must leave central treasure visible. Everything built in/on the square footprint, on dark underground rock; four distinct large tile quadrants, doorway attached correctly to adjacent walls. The treasure is ONE large centered object or uninterrupted hoard, occupying about 45% of the room's width with a usable ring around it; NOTHING in the corners that reads as an extra treasure chest. Highlight walls and corners, door design, and distinctive silhouette, not just color changes. Warm gold treasure vs cold stone; sparse violet magic. No words, labels, diagrams, HUD, adventurers or signatures. Wide composition with generous margins; show all of the room and at most two plain corridor tiles for scale. Paint a finished stylized game environment asset at gameplay scale, no photographic bokeh, minute decorative noise or epic distant scenery. DIRECTION A ONLY: RELIQUARY OF THE WATCHING SEAL. Severe ritual geometry and a quiet, jewel-like silhouette. Four stepped octagonal slate pylons crowned with small faceted violet seals; recessed rear wall bays carved into a continuous eye frieze with narrow antique-brass ribs. A symmetrical central low hexagonal black-stone reliquary, ONE broad lid cracked open along one edge to reveal a luminous sliver of closely packed little gold coins. Its one violet eye seal on the front dominates the face. Front door is a single black-metal leaf with two horizontal brass latches and a modest violet lens in its stone arch. Floor: sober purple/slate mosaic with one continuous bronze outline to tie the architecture together. Restrained, ominous; avoid cathedral spires or excessive gold.
